messages:
Asha (people-ops): Heads up — Ben Li submitted his resignation, last day Friday 2026-04-10. Need a plan for knowledge capture and access cutover. He's the primary owner for private-deploy infra and oncall rotation this week. @Tom can you confirm coverage?
Tom (eng-manager): Thanks. I'll take interim oncall for the weekend, Jared will shadow next week. Need a checklist for repo and infra handoffs.
Ben Li: Happy to do knowledge docs. I'm out of town Wed-Fri but can record 2 short walkthroughs Mon/Tue. I’ll drop asset inventory today.
Priya (it-access): Please include list of AWS roles, service accounts, KMS keys, and GitHub org access. We prefer to do deprovision 48 hours after last day unless there's active handoff.
Jared (eng-platform): On the infra side: QA-private deployment + L4 load balancer + autoscale groups. I'll create a runbook and transfer ownership in PagerDuty. Will need Ben to grant temporary admin on the deployment for 72h to verify transfers.
Nadia (security): KMS/HSM key rotation required if Ben has sole access. @Priya — can we schedule key rotation + access audit on Mon 2026-04-13? Also want export of SSH key usage.
Asha (people-ops): Benefits note: COBRA window email goes out day after termination, coverage end 4/30 per payroll. @benefits-bot can you confirm the COBRA enrollment link gets sent on 4/11?
benefits-bot: COBRA notice scheduled for 2026-04-11 09:00 UTC. Enrollment link: https://benefits.example/cobra/ben.li
Tom (eng-manager): Quick checklist from us:
```
- 2x walkthrough videos (codebase, infra)
- Ownership transfer PRs for repos
- PagerDuty / oncall update
- AWS role handoff
- KMS key rotation / audit
- Laptop return label + asset form
```
Asha (people-ops): Ben — for equipment please drop off via prepaid label within 7 days of last day. We'll process final paycheck + any reimbursements on next payroll. Fill this form: https://hr.example/offboard-assets
Ben Li: Got it. I'll upload walkthroughs Mon morning, and I can be online Tue afternoon for the handover session. I've created the asset list: `assets/ben_li_equipment.pdf`
Priya (it-access): After Ben uploads docs, I'll approve a 72-hour admin window starting Tue 2026-04-07 14:00 UTC. After that, roles will be revoked and keys rotated. Tagging @Nadia once rotation is done.
Nadia (security): Sounds good. I'll run the export and post findings to the thread once complete.
Tom (eng-manager): I'll file a brief exit interview link for Ben and schedule with @Asha. Thanks everyone — feel free to add any missed items.
Asha (people-ops): Scheduling note: Exit interview 2026-04-09 11:00 PT. @Ben Li pls confirm. Also we will start deprovision at 2026-04-11 10:00 PT if all handoffs completed.
Ben Li: Confirmed for 4/9 11:00 PT. Thanks y'all — will get the videos and PRs up Monday.
